name: Condado Time Adherence - Daily Burn-up
query:
SELECT
  x.d AS "Date:Date:95",
  x.label AS "Day::110",
  COUNT(*) AS "People:Int:70",
  ROUND(SUM(x.tgt), 1) AS "Hours Target:Float:110",
  ROUND(SUM(x.hrs), 1) AS "Hours Logged:Float:110",
  ROUND(SUM(0.8 * GREATEST(x.tgt - x.pto, 0)), 1) AS "Billable Target:Float:120",
  ROUND(SUM(x.bill), 1) AS "Billable Logged:Float:120",
  ROUND(GREATEST(SUM(x.tgt) - SUM(x.hrs), 0), 1) AS "Hours Behind:Float:110"
FROM (
  SELECT dd.d,
    CONCAT(LEFT(DAYNAME(dd.d), 3), ' ', LEFT(MONTHNAME(dd.d), 3), ' ', DAY(dd.d), IF(dd.d = CURDATE(), ' (today)', '')) AS label,
    e.name AS employee,
    8 * GREATEST(DAYOFWEEK(dd.d) - 1
      - IFNULL((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hl.holiday_date) FROM `tabHoliday` hl
                 WHERE hl.parent = e.holiday_list AND IFNULL(hl.weekly_off, 0) = 0
                   AND DAYOFWEEK(hl.holiday_date) BETWEEN 2 AND 6
                   AND hl.holiday_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL DAYOFWEEK(CURDATE()) - 1 DAY)
                   AND hl.holiday_date <= dd.d), 0), 0) AS tgt,
    IFNULL((SELECT SUM(td.hours) FROM `tabTimesheet Detail` td
             JOIN `tabTimesheet` t ON t.name = td.parent AND td.parenttype = 'Timesheet'
            WHERE t.employee = e.name AND t.docstatus < 2
              AND td.from_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL DAYOFWEEK(CURDATE()) - 1 DAY)
              AND td.from_time < DATE_ADD(dd.d, INTERVAL 1 DAY)), 0) AS hrs,
    IFNULL((SELECT SUM(td.hours) FROM `tabTimesheet Detail` td
             JOIN `tabTimesheet` t ON t.name = td.parent AND td.parenttype = 'Timesheet'
            WHERE t.employee = e.name AND t.docstatus < 2 AND td.is_billable = 1
              AND td.from_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL DAYOFWEEK(CURDATE()) - 1 DAY)
              AND td.from_time < DATE_ADD(dd.d, INTERVAL 1 DAY)), 0) AS bill,
    IFNULL((SELECT SUM(td.hours) FROM `tabTimesheet Detail` td
             JOIN `tabTimesheet` t ON t.name = td.parent AND td.parenttype = 'Timesheet'
            WHERE t.employee = e.name AND t.docstatus < 2 AND td.project = '[Internal] - PTO'
              AND td.from_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL DAYOFWEEK(CURDATE()) - 1 DAY)
              AND td.from_time < DATE_ADD(dd.d, INTERVAL 1 DAY)), 0) AS pto
  FROM (
    SELECT DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL DAYOFWEEK(CURDATE()) - 1 DAY), INTERVAL n.n DAY) AS d
    FROM (SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5) n
  ) dd
  CROSS JOIN `tabEmployee` e
  WHERE dd.d <= CURDATE()
    AND e.company = 'Condado Group Inc.'
    AND e.status = 'Active'
    AND IFNULL(e.user_id, '') NOT IN ('', 'timesheet@cp.com')
) x
GROUP BY x.d, x.label
ORDER BY x.d ASC
